title: Binance Will Add aixbt by Virtuals (AIXBT), ChainGPT (CGPT) and Cookie DAO (COOKIE) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert & Margin
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  aixbt by Virtuals (AIXBT), ChainGPT (CGPT) and Cookie DAO (COOKIE)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert ,  Binance Margin  and  Binance Auto-Invest  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn AIXBT ,  CGPT  and  COOKIE  Flexible Products will be listed on Binance Simple Earn at  2025-01-10 13:00 (UTC)  and will be  available for subscription . From  2025-01-13 10:00 (UTC) , users may purchase  AIXBT, CGPT and COOKIE  using any of the payment options supported on  Binance Auto-Invest . Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy  AIXBT, CGPT and COOKIE  with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay,  or buy and sell  AIXBT, CGPT and COOKIE  with their  wallet balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of  AIXBT, CGPT and COOKIE  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading  AIXBT, CGPT and COOKIE  against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of  AIXBT, CGPT and COOKIE  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Binance Margin will add  AIXBT, CGPT and COOKIE  as new borrowable assets on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  AIXBT/USDT ,  AIXBT/USDC ,  CGPT/USDT ,  CGPT/USDC ,  COOKIE/USDT ,  COOKIE/USDC  pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2025-01-10 15:30 (UTC). Binance VIP 7 to VIP 9 users will be able to borrow the abovementioned asset(s) on Cross and Isolated Margin approximately 30 minutes before it is open for Margin trading.  Note:  Interest is charged on these loans even though margin trading for these tokens has not commenced. Please note that newly listed tokens tend to be volatile; users are encouraged to adopt stringent risk management strategies when trading such tokens. Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. You may contact Circle using the following contact information: +33(1)59000130 and EEA-Customer-Support@circle.com.  Holders of USDC have a legal claim against Circle SAS as the EU issuer of USDC. These holders are entitled to request redemption of their USDC from Circle SAS. Such redemption will be made at any time and at par value.
